name: deepscientist-lite
description: Keep a Codex research project recoverable: record goals, routes, experiments, evidence, reviews, and next steps in local files.

interface.shortDescription: Keep research goals, experiments, evidence, and next steps easy to recover and review.
interface.longDescription: DeepScientist Lite is an independent, unofficial Codex plugin for teaching and small research projects. Twenty-six skills combine the nine DS Lite continuity and evidence workflows with the complete nature-skills academic search, writing, review, data, figure, citation, response, statistics, and submission workflows. Local project files preserve the current route and supporting evidence across sessions. MCP and external integrations are opt-in through a workspace onboarding guide; the plugin does not silently change global configuration or prove that a scientific claim is true. It is not sponsored, certified, or endorsed by ResearAI.
defaultPrompt: $ds-lite take over or resume this research or engineering project, explain why the plugin applies, route one bounded action, and stop
$ds-lite-iterate advance one plan-execute-verify-reflect-report cycle and stop at a visible checkpoint
$ds-lite-review check whether this experiment is ready to support an analysis
